crossRefs.note: and he sent and beheaded John in the prison.
His head was brought on a platter, and given to the young lady; and she brought it to her mother.

parallels.note: and he sent and beheaded John in the prison.

translations.web: Immediately the king sent out a soldier of his guard, and commanded to bring John’s head, and he went and beheaded him in the prison,
translations.bsb: So without delay, the king commanded that John’s head be brought in. He sent an executioner, who went and beheaded him in the prison.
translations.kjv: And immediately the king sent an executioner, and commanded his head to be brought: and he went and beheaded him in the prison,
translations.asv: And straightway the king sent forth a soldier of his guard, and commanded to bring his head: and he went and beheaded him in the prison,
